text:
Liam: Heads up — EU-Central queue depth for mosaic-7b tails is spiking. 95th/p99 latency creeping past 450ms, queue depth ~7.8k (≈3x norm). GPUs ~92% util, memory ok. tagging @Priya @Ashley for triage. :warning:

ops-bot: Alert: queue-depth-high eu-central mosaic-7b (alert_id=QDH-20260320-01)

Priya: On it. Any signal if this is a single-customer burst or broad traffic pattern?

Liam: Looks broad but concentrated on route /v1/generate-mosaic-7b — high concurrency, lots of short prompts. Per-model counters show ~87% from free-tier routes (tier=free).

Ashley: Can we flip soft-throttle on free-tier (20 rps/shard) and also reduce batch size for mosaic-7b (64->32) to cut tail latency? Will increase token cost slightly but reduce queueing.

Daniel: Agree with soft-throttle. Scaling new nodes in eu-central has ~10–12m lead time; admission control + spillover are faster. Suggest spillover to us-west2 for up to 15% low-priority traffic.

Priya: Agreed. Plan: admission.rate_limit.model:mosaic-7b.free_tier=20, admission.spillover.allow=true, admission.spillover.targets=["us-west2"] with cap=15%. Implement as canary 10% for 5m.

Liam: Also recommend preempting queued low-priority work: label priority=low => move to preemptible queue and evict after 30s to free in-flight slots. Quicker than waiting for scale.

Ashley: For premium routes, we can route to quantized-8bit variant in-eu to shave per-token time (~12%) while keeping premium quality intact. That reduces pressure without routing premium out-of-region.

Daniel: I'll open the routing + admission PR. Priya, want me to include the k8s patch?

Priya: Yes — include this for quick patch:
```
kubectl patch configmap admission --type merge -p '{"data": {"mosaic-7b.free_rps": "20","spillover.targets": "us-west2"}}'
```
I'll stage the change and enable canary 10% at 1717001300.

Liam: Dashboards updated (dashboard: /d/eu-central/mosaic-7b). Watching queue depth, latency and error rate. Abort if errors >0.5% or 95th latency climbs further.

ops-bot: Incident note: mitigation started by Priya at 1717001300 — canary routing 10% enabled; admission caps applied.

Ashley: Also disable aggressive KV cache eviction for mosaic-7b for now — caching helps tails for repeated prefixes. Tradeoff: memory pressure up a bit.

Daniel: PR opened: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3192 (routing + admission). Will tag @Priya for approval. Rolling canary will be 10% -> 50% if stable.

Priya: Assigning runbook tasks: /assign @Priya push admission patch, /assign @Daniel open + merge routing PR, /assign @Liam monitor dashboards and decide on full spillover. ETA 15m for first verdict.

Liam: :thumbsup: starting watch now. Will post update at +5m.
